doctrine: Raw source sheets are immutable reference/input assets.
Mechanical slicing/indexing is inspection only, not runtime authority.
Runtime/editor authority starts at certified published metadata.
Generated catalogs and caches are disposable and recoverable.
Legacy object/tile aliases are compatibility adapters, not source authority.
Validators verify contracts; they do not invent art rules or reshape worlds.

authorityLayers.hardFailWhen: certified production asset points to a missing source
never by itself; corruption triggers regenerate/quarantine
production-enabled pack lacks approved provenance/license or duplicate ids
stable id, source, footprint, anchor, or compatibility contract is broken
schema, tile size, source rect, atlas path, domain, or certification is invalid

authorityLayers.role: view over certified/published assets plus source-inspection candidates
authorityLayers.hardFailWhen: it paints uncertified source references as runtime assets
never alone; bad cache should be quarantined and rebuilt

nextImplementationPasses: Assets Studio must stay navigable if artifacts/asset-intake/asset-catalog.json is corrupt.
Palette must prioritize published/certified assets and keep source references non-placeable until promotion.
Terrain/cliff/water generation must consume published topology ids rather than raw atlas cells.
Tool/hotbar/equipment icons must come from real item/tool art, not drawn placeholders.
